name: AUTH-REVOKED-STREAM
status: G6 producer implementation; consumer integration pending

stream.entry: Exactly one UTF-8 field event containing the full SessionRevoked JSON envelope.
stream.id: Redis stream ID is independent of the stable eventId.
stream.order: No global or cross-instance ordering guarantee.

semantics.boundary: Redis session deletion is confirmed first; intent REVOKED and outbox fact are committed together. PENDING or CLAIMED is not published. PUBLISHED means XADD accepted and DB acknowledgement committed; it does not mean any consumer processed the event.
semantics.delivery: At least once. An XADD followed by failed DB acknowledgement can repeat the same immutable eventId and JSON. Consumers must persist deduplication atomically with their own effect.
semantics.scope: Only aggregateId/payload.sid and its current executions are targeted. userId is descriptive and must never select other sessions.

reasons.ACCOUNT_SECURITY_CHANGED: Explicit account status, password, or deletion action
reasons.UNSPECIFIED: Historical fact with no recorded reason, or general administrator edit whose exact security change is not established

operations.replay: POST /api/admin/auth/session-events/{eventId}/replay requires system:session-event:replay; only DEAD; same eventId, transactionally audited
operations.retries: Finite per-item lease and batch, capped exponential delay, DEAD after configured attempts. Expired claims recover; no event is discarded.
operations.redaction: Only constant delivery error codes retained; no token, credentials, or personal profile in envelope, operations, or logs.

retention.local: Published facts and matching completed coordination/index rows only, or naturally expired session indexes with no intent/outbox, older than configured retention (minimum 7 days, default 30 days), bounded batches. Pending, claimed, DEAD, and unrepresented historical intents are preserved.
retention.stream: No XTRIM by producer. Operators and consumers must agree retention and durable consumer watermarks before any independent trimming.
retention.historicalGap: Existing G3 REVOKED intents without outbox remain absent; no automatic backfill.

readiness: Disabled reports DISABLED. Enabled probes a separate stream with atomic MULTI/XADD/EXPIRE/EXEC and exact-key DEL. Target-key ACL may differ and is explicitly reported unverified; most recent successful publication is exposed, not a guarantee of current target ACL.
notImplemented: Agent consumption, deduplication, pause/checkpoint and downstream completion.
